title: Settlement Pricing Desk Rate Sheet: Three-Payment Settlement Offer Percentage and Amount
content:
# Three-Payment Settlement — Rate Sheet

**Floors.** For a Three-Payment Settlement offer under Ridgeline's Settlement Agreements, the Three-Payment authority floor for the account's current placement stage is 100.0 for Early-Out Placement, 78.0 for Primary Placement, 63.0 for Secondary Placement, 53.0 for Tertiary Placement, 43.0 for Warehouse Placement and 83.0 for Legal Review Placement, and the Three-Payment approval floor for the same stages is 100.0, 58.0, 48.0, 38.0, 28.0 and 68.0 in that order.

| Stage | Early-Out | Primary | Secondary | Tertiary | Warehouse | Legal Review |
|---|---|---|---|---|---|---|
| Three-Payment authority floor | 100.0 | 78.0 | 63.0 | 53.0 | 43.0 | 83.0 |
| Three-Payment approval floor | 100.0 | 58.0 | 48.0 | 38.0 | 28.0 | 68.0 |

**Bundle flag and bundle reduction.** Where the consumer holds at least two accounts placed under the account's client agreement, the Three-Payment offer carries the bundle flag set to true and the Three-Payment authority floor is lowered by the Three-Payment bundle reduction of 2.0 percentage points; otherwise the bundle flag is false and nothing is lowered.

**Bundle composition.** Where the consumer holds other open accounts placed under the same client agreement, Ridgeline extends the Three-Payment offer only as part of a same-client bundle covering every one of them: an other account whose balance due is at least the Three-Payment entry gate of 500.00 dollars joins under a Three-Payment offer and one whose balance due is under that gate but at least the Two-Payment entry gate of 300.00 dollars joins under a Two-Payment offer. Every offer of a same-client bundle is dated the same offer date, and a bundle may mix Three-Payment and Two-Payment offers.

**Offer percentage.** The Three-Payment offer percentage is the Three-Payment authority floor less any same-client bundle reduction, never set below the Three-Payment approval floor for the stage.

The Three-Payment offer percentage is worked out in this order: first the Three-Payment authority floor for the stage is taken, then the same-client bundle reduction and every Three-Payment reduction that applies are added together and subtracted from it once, then any Three-Payment raise is added, and only then is that figure compared with the Three-Payment approval floor for the stage, the higher of the two being the Three-Payment offer percentage.

The Three-Payment offer percentage is carried to one decimal place and the settlement amount is computed from it.

**Settlement amount.** The Three-Payment settlement amount is the account's balance due on the offer date times the Three-Payment offer percentage divided by 100, rounded up to the next whole dollar only once at the end; an amount below 150.00 dollars is never offered under this rule.

**Own-authority limits.** A Three-Payment offer under this rule never relies on a client approval: it is extended only where the account's balance due is no more than 25,000.00 dollars and the balance due less the settlement amount is no more than 10,000.00 dollars, and it carries no approval request.

## Hypothetical worked figures

| Hypothetical inputs | Offer percentage | Amount before rounding | Settlement amount |
|---|---|---|---|
| Primary Placement, a single account under the agreement, balance due 640.50 dollars | 78.0 | 499.59 | 500.00 dollars |
| Tertiary Placement, two accounts under the agreement, balance due 2000.00 dollars | 53.0 less 2.0, that is 51.0 | 1020.00 | 1020.00 dollars |
| Warehouse Placement, a single account, balance due 320.00 dollars | 43.0 | 137.60 | below 150.00 dollars, not offered under this rule |
